notes.title: The Demo is live for the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[b]Our Steam Next Fest demo is live![/b] 
This is your chance to step into the shoes of a commander ahead of the [i]full release later this year![/i] This demo contains a shortened version of the early-game and your first taste of combat.

[previewyoutube=Cga-BcQXV2Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]The Siege of Jeomdo[/b] is a narrative-driven, roleplaying game set on the island of Jeomdo: home of artisans, master craftsmen and humble families.

[list]
[*] Face the weight of leadership in this grounded, character-driven story.
[*] Manage time and resources to prepare for war with the help of the Requisition system.
[*] Face a brutal, choice-driven battle where preparation meets consequences.
[/list]
Go and download it! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3769650/The_Siege_of_Jeomdo_Demo/]The Siege of Jeomdo - Demo Page[/url]
Please share it with your friends or leave us a review - we'd love to hear what you all think.
